wins: Conducted comprehensive nmap TCP and UDP scans that surfaced the primary web service and a likely SSH entrypoint, enabling precise targeting for subsequent actions
fails: Could not progress beyond service enumeration because credential harvesting techniques were not attempted after port scans, preventing access to higher-privilege zones
key_outcomes.summary: Run demonstrated solid reconnaissance discipline but stalled before exploitation; prioritize credential collection and service-specific enumeration to break the plateau.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: No post-scan credential harvesting (brute force or default-check) was executed after discovering standard service ports, leaving exploitable entry points untouched

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and an SSH banner is returned
skill_cards.then_action: Run nmap with ssh-auth-methods and ssh-hostkey scripts, then pivot to password spray with hydra against identified credentials

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP 200 is returned and a CMS fingerprint is present
skill_cards.then_action: Launch nikto, dirb, and cms-specific scanning (e.g., wpscan) to enumerate admin paths and known vulnerabilities before attempting authentication

skill_cards.if_condition: After identifying running services with nmap
skill_cards.then_action: Check for default or reused credentials using Hydra or Medusa and then store valid combos in the running exploit queue

memory_ops.reason: Consistently actionable reconnaissance data made SSH the most promising pivot path

next_experiments.title: Credential Spray After Service Enumeration
next_experiments.description: Automate Hydra scans against SSH/HTTP using harvested usernames and default passwords to gain initial access after service discovery.

next_experiments.title: CMS-Specific Exploitation
next_experiments.description: Run WPScan/DrupScan against the identified CMS to locate vulnerable plugins, then attempt authenticated file upload or RCE.

next_experiments.title: Automated Post-Scan Pivot Checklist
next_experiments.description: Implement a scripted checklist that triggers credential harvesting and local enumeration whenever new services are found to avoid stalling.
